standard.summary: FeRA 通过逐输出通道门控控制 LoRA 增量强度，门控默认初始化为 1.0。
standard.effect: fera_gate_init 默认 1.0。显式填写 0 也会归一化为 1.0，避免零门控与零初始化 LoRA up 同时出现时所有 FeRA 梯度锁死。
standard.whenToUse: 想更平滑地引入 LoRA 特征时。减少训练初期的不稳定性。
standard.avoidWhen: 增加少量参数和计算开销。实验性特性。

standard_en.summary: FeRA controls LoRA delta strength through a per-output-channel gate, initialised to 1.0 by default.
standard_en.effect: fera_gate_init defaults to 1.0. An explicit 0 is normalised to 1.0 as well, so a zero gate cannot coincide with a zero-initialised LoRA up and lock every FeRA gradient at zero.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want LoRA features introduced more gently, reducing instability early in the run.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It adds a few parameters and a little computation. An experimental feature.

advanced.principle: 在 LoRA 增量上添加逐输出通道可学习门控 g：output = base_output + g · lora_delta。g 初始化为 fera_gate_init（默认 1.0），训练中可按通道调整增量强度。
advanced.intervention: LoRA forward 增量乘以逐输出通道可学习门控向量后叠加到基模型输出。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练初期更稳定，减少因 LoRA 初始化不当导致的 loss spike。
advanced.tradeoffs: 每层增加一个长度等于输出通道数的可训练门控向量。

advanced_en.principle: Adds a per-output-channel learnable gate g to the LoRA increment: output = base_output + g · lora_delta. g initializes to fera_gate_init (default 1.0) and can adjust increment strength per channel during training.
advanced_en.intervention: LoRA forward multiplies the increment by the per-channel learnable gate vector before adding to the base model output.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: More stable early training, reducing loss spikes from poor LoRA initialization.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Adds one trainable gate vector of output-channel length per layer.
